hits.text: Storing dry and opened canned food. Cornell recommends storing dry cat food in a cool, dry place, checking its expiry date and using an airtight container to help preserve nutrients and flavour. Prolonged storage can degrade vitamins and allow fats to become rancid. Refrigerate unused portions of opened canned food to preserve quality and reduce spoilage.
